div.head: Hn 31.7
div.ab: Unusquisque per pares suos iudicandus est et eiusdem prouincie.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 564 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: Selbst im Grafschaftsgericht (meinen Pol Mai I 152. 392) gab es Barone genug, um selbst Barone abzuurteilen. In Normandie: Par per parem iudicari debet, barones et milites possunt iudicare unus alium et subditum; rustico non licet uel alii de populo militem uel clericum iudicare; Très anc. cout. I 26. Vgl. Stand 12c; Standesgenossen 8a; Urteilfinder 9

Even in the county court (as Pol Mai I 152. 392 hold) there were barons enough to pass judgment even on barons. In Normandy: Par per parem iudicari debet, barones et milites possunt iudicare unus alium et subditum; rustico non licet uel alii de populo militem uel clericum iudicare; Très anc. cout. I 26. Cf. Stand 12c; Standesgenossen 8a; Urteilfinder 9
